## Checklist

`title` + `items[]` of **Checklist Item** (`label`, `kind` check / measure / photo / text / signature, `required`, `expectedValue` ± `tolerance` in `unit` for measures, `result` pending / pass / fail / na, `value`, `photoUrl`, `note`, `completedByName/At`). A measure outside tolerance auto-fails and reports the delta.

Computed: `total`, `done`, `failedCount`, `requiredRemaining`, `completionPercent`, `isComplete` — via `checklistStats` in `utils/maintenance.ts`, shared with the **Checklist Runner** component and **Complete Work Order** so they agree on “complete”.

Lives twice by design: as a **template** on a Maintenance Plan (no results) and as a deep **copy** on each Work Order (`cloneChecklistItems`). Results never flow back.

Generic: onboarding checklists, publish checklists and audit procedures can carry it; the Runner executes any of them.
